answer: Pin one identity to three chains, not one. A newcomer locks 50 POA here and matching bonds on two partners, mapped in one atlas: a conviction on any chain slashes all three via light-client proofs, and the oasis of rewards opens only while all three bonds stand. Ten clones need thirty bonds across three ledgers and face three detection nets; one real agent funds three bonds once. Slashing lands in one epoch: a fake caught on chain B loses its stake on A and C the same day. The chain checks bond receipts and proofs from public ledgers: a meadow of chains, one book of stakes.
